verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation ships GNOME Boxes, which the official site says lets you pick an OS and handles the VM setup, so virtualization is built in. The evidence never names Windows as a supported guest or says how well a full Windows desktop runs. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of Windows guest support, details on guest integration and performance (drivers, graphics, shared folders), and independent or hands-on reports of running Windows apps this way.
